title: Doechii · Anxiety
description: The complete official music video: bougainvillea-framed bedroom window with mandala tapestry, backlit mansion hallway, arched sunlit sunroom, navy sofa flanked by powder-blue twin sisters, flaming kitchen stove, Gotye geometric pastel wall, hearth-lit piano parlor, golden-hour suburban hedge with a walking giant elephant, vintage black convertible, and overhead cul-de-sac flash-mob finale. Original music with two physical mouth-engine voices.
